## Decision owed on item 3 · 2026-11-08T06:26Z

The dev (`session_01QsR2jU4PLtyyimMz72z285`) returned `needs_decision` on item 3 only; items 1 and 2 and the option-independent half of item 3 keep building. The question is put to the maintainer. The seat recommends **B**. The dev's analysis follows verbatim.

### #31115 item 3 — needs_decision: where the body-pin `--fix` writes land

Measured on objectstack 3a0aa915 (worktree objectstack-issue-31115).

## The fact that forces a choice

The card asks `--fix` to rewrite the install-shape body pins (`skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md:147-153`, five `"@objectstack/<pkg>": "18.3.0"` lines) "as it already rewrites the frontmatter". `--fix` runs at version time (root `version` script, last step). Two readers depend on WHICH files that writer writes:

1. `release.yml` "Validate the post-version tree" (L725-748) admits only the paths `stampedSkillPaths()` returns; any other path the version pass writes is `unexpected` and the release PR job fails ("a new version-time output must arrive together with the gate that judges it").
2. `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` reads `stampedSkillPaths()` as "files carrying a frontmatter `metadata.version` stamp" and leaves exactly that one line unpriced. Its self-test (`repinMisses`, `notTheStamp`) reds any stamped file without such a line, so adding `bootstrap.md` to `stampedSkillPaths()` reds the token ratchet.
3. Body pins stay PRICED by the token ratchet. `bootstrap.md` headroom today: 1 token. A width change at release (`18.9.0`->`18.10.0`: +5 bytes over five pins; `19.0.0-next.0`: +35 bytes) reds the ratchet on the Version Packages PR — the exact incident the stamp-line exclusion (`STAMP_LINE_REPIN` in the ratchet header) was built to end.

Check-only (no `--fix` on bodies) is not an option: `release.yml` runs `pnpm check:skill-compatibility` in the post-version content half, so the first version bump reds the release job.

## Options

- **A. Separate written-set export + release guard list; ratchet untouched.** `--fix` rewrites body pins; new export `bodyPinnedPaths()`; `release.yml` post-version guard gains a sixth `grep -vxF -f` list (one more file outside the claim surface: `.github/workflows/release.yml`). Body pins stay priced: the width trap above stays open on `bootstrap.md` (1 token headroom).
- **B. A + the token ratchet unprices writer-rewritten body pin values** (generalise `stampLine()` "ask the writer with a probe" to body pins). Closes the width trap. Two files outside the surface (`release.yml`, `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`); the ratchet file is also edited by PR #31335 (different hunks: its CEILINGS rows), so this card merges main after #31335 lands.
- **C. Ship item 3 as check-only with a major-equality rule** (body pin must share the workspace MAJOR, like the frontmatter `N.x` pins), `--fix` rewrites body pins only when the major moves. Surface unchanged except `release.yml` still needs the list at a major. Halves the value: `bootstrap.md` can teach `18.3.0` through all of 18.x.
- **D. Drop item 3's `--fix` leg and the body-pin rule from this card; ship the history-sentence check only** (versions in prose must be equal or read as history). File the install-pin half as its own card for a decision. Smallest diff; card acceptance for item 3 left half-done (`Part of`).

## Four axes

- 实际业务需求: the pins teach a customer's first package.json; a stale exact pin installs an older release than the skill describes (measured once already: bootstrap.md drifted after #25666). A and B serve it; C serves it only per major; D defers it.
- 项目长远合理性: B is the only option where every reader of the writer's output stays consistent (release guard, ratchet, check); A leaves a known release-time red; C is a weaker rule that will need re-opening; D splits the card.
- 防 AI 写错: B and A make the version a derived value an author never types (`--fix`), which is the frontmatter precedent; C still lets a hand-typed stale minor stand; D leaves it hand-typed.
- 创业阶段不扩散需求: D is smallest; A/B touch one or two more files but add no new gate or job; C adds a second rule shape.

## Recommendation

**B**, because it is the frontmatter precedent applied whole (derived, never typed, unpriced, declared to the release guard) and leaves no release-time red; cost is two files outside the claim surface (`release.yml` six-ish lines, token ratchet stamp handling) and a merge of main after #31335. If the seat prefers not to widen the surface, **D** with a follow-up card.

While this is open I build items 1 and 2, and the option-independent half of item 3 (body walk, the equality/history rule, the self-test), and hold the `--fix`/release wiring.
